//Mfa: Step-up: officer decisions need a sign-in with the authenticator code while true. Keep it equal to the IDP's Mfa:Enabled.

Mfa.//StepUpMaxAgeMinutes: While MFA is on, a decision needs a sign-in with the authenticator code at most this many minutes old (1-60).

Payments.//ApprovalLimits: What a payments officer may approve, by clearance level: an amount, or "Unlimited" (blank or missing stops the start-up); below the lowest level nothing.
Payments.//Outbox: The relay's publish attempts per message before it is PARKED (operations resend it on the Processing Monitor); the n-th attempt after BaseDelaySeconds x 2^(n-1).
